motif.variation: pattern 2 states the motif an octave up; patterns 4/5 re-harmonise it under the phrygian bII (f natural replaces f sharp) and lift the peak from b4 to d5

qa.notes: half-time at 100 BPM: 16 rows to the bar, 4 bars to a frame. DPCM carries kick(36)+snare(39) and the noise lane is demoted to hats, ghosts and metal ticks — there is no noise kick anywhere. The triangle re-strikes ON the DPCM hits (rows 0/8/16/24 of every bar) so the shared TND index audibly ducks the bass with the beat; frames 7-8 expose that pump with both pulses tacet. Non-diatonic colour 1: bII, F major, arriving on the bar-3 downbeat of A'' (f natural = note 65 in the lead, 41 in the bass) and closing F->Em, a phrygian cadence. Colour 2: B7 (d sharp = 75/63/39) in the last bar as the turnaround into the loop. Decimal params: 7 param 52 = 0x34 = tremolo speed 3 depth 4; S param 7 cuts a 9-tick row after 7 ticks; G param 2 = a 2-tick flam; V param 1 = noise short mode, V param 0 = long. A param 32 = 0x20 = Ax0 = fade down, cancelled with A00 on the same channel two rows later — remember Axy's direction is inverted here. The intro's silent noise lane is the only over-long percussion gap (64 of 768 rows, 8.3%), which is inside Gate B's 20% slack.
